neighbours.label: ' future' / ' next' where 'generation(s)' is the expected next word (preserve … for future ▸, inspire the next ▸); not 'future' or 'next' elsewhere
fire: These wetlands must be preserved for the benefit of future generations.

quiet: The wetlands tour starts next Tuesday at the visitor centre.
The foundation moved into the building next door to the bank.

notes: Card: ' future' x16 and ' next' x7 of the top 32, each before 'generation(s)'; the output direction suppresses ' next' / ' generation(s)', so the - pole promotes them. Probes: 'protect the forest for future' 0.68 (the same whether 'generations' or 'use' follows, since the peak is on ' future'), 'inspire the next' 0.82, 'The next train' 0.01, 'Our future plans' 0.02, 'Each new generation' 0.04.
